drey_ig.caption:
You're the bottleneck in your own business because every robotic task still runs through you.

Anything you do that's robotic, hand it to AI. I get around a thousand emails a day, so an agent goes through them and pulls out what matters. AI drafts my client agreements and tells me what I might have missed on a call. Now it even posts my videos straight from Google Drive. All these little things add up, and your days get simpler.

AI systems instead of hiring an employee take the robotic work off your plate first: the inbox, the paperwork, the call notes and the posting.

What's the most robotic thing you still do every week? Follow for AI systems instead of hiring an employee.

You're paying $200 a month for Claude and it costs way more than that to run.

That plan is about $20,000 worth of compute: the data centers, the electricity, the cooling. Running your own model at home starts around $80,000 in equipment before the power bill.

AI systems cost far less than hiring an employee because you rent that compute for $200 a month instead of buying it.

Follow for AI systems instead of hiring an employee.

You're putting every hour into a plan the numbers already called a long shot.

At 5'6", my odds of playing basketball at the top level were very slim. I didn't quit the game. I looked at the G League and overseas, and asked myself if I wanted the highest level or just loved the sport. You can go against the odds. Just know your probability.

Know your odds in business too. When you're out of time and money for a new hire, AI systems instead of hiring an employee are the higher probability bet.

Did you ever chase something everyone called a long shot? Follow for AI systems instead of hiring an employee.

You keep putting off the one conversation that would free up your week.

Nothing is as scary as you think it is. When something scares me, I walk toward it. I was talking to a girl, we stopped talking, and instead of letting it sit I walked right up to her and talked to her. If it's on your mind and you feel it's on theirs, it's better to just say it.

Same with the hard business call, like handing the busywork to AI systems instead of hiring an employee. It feels scary until you do it.

What conversation have you been avoiding? Follow for AI systems instead of hiring an employee.

You're too busy to meet every client face to face, so the moments you do get have to count.

My smile is probably 80 percent of my success. I used to force it in every photo. Now I let it show up on its own. Your smile is your smile, and picking it apart is useless.

When AI systems handle the busywork instead of hiring an employee, you get your time back for the in person moments that actually build trust.

What do people always notice about you first? Follow for AI systems instead of hiring an employee.

You're too busy to read every message before it goes out, and that's exactly when AI gets scary.

I have hard rules. Nothing goes to anyone until I say the words "I approve" or "send it." My code works the same way: no changes ship until I say "ship it." And when I do let my AI send something, I tell people it came from my AI.

AI systems instead of hiring an employee give you your hours back when the AI writes every draft and nothing goes out in your name until you say two words.

What would you never let AI send for you? Follow for AI systems instead of hiring an employee.

You don't have the money or the time to hire help yet, so it feels like you're stuck.

You don't need more resources. You need resourcefulness. Short on money? What service can you do for someone to get it? Need help? Who can you talk to so you don't have to learn the thing to get the thing?

AI systems instead of hiring an employee is resourcefulness in practice: the work gets done without a new hire or a new skill.

What are you short on right now, time or money? Follow for AI systems instead of hiring an employee.

kevin_ig.caption: I wanted the business, the peace, the relationships, all of it. I just felt like the weight was all on my shoulders and I had nobody to do it with. That's when I surrendered. God didn't just lighten the load, He took it. If you're carrying something right now that feels too heavy, send this to someone who needs to hear it.

Someone wanted access to your life. Access to your time, your body, your attention, your yes.

This time you caught it before it got in the door.

A client of mine went on a few dates with a guy. No rush, nothing physical. He told her he had a lot of emotional damage to work through and couldn't give her what she was looking for. Then he flipped the script and said he wanted something casual instead.

She told him no. Said she respects and loves herself too much for that.

That is someone recognizing control before it got a grip on her. The old version of her would have stayed to fix him, to prove she was patient enough, loving enough, worth staying for. This version saw the pattern and walked.

Here's what I want you to get from this. Recognizing manipulation is step one, and cutting the person out is step two, which is where most people never get to. They catch the red flag, then keep the person around anyway because leaving feels mean, or lonely, or like giving up on someone.

You don't owe access to anyone who only shows up wanting control, not your time, not your body, not another chance to talk you back into their orbit.

Swipe through for what this actually looks like.

Real connection doesn't happen online. The people who you build real connection, friendships and relationships with are in the rooms that you want to be in. You surround yourself with people who are aligned with you. That's why Jenna built volleyball paradise and that's why we built the 1BB Owners Club. Yes we want to teach people skills and help them make improvements but the right people and relationships are so valuable. What rooms are you in? More importantly what rooms are you not in that you should be in?

I used to tell myself I don't have time to play volleyball, but that was just a lie I was making up in my head. When I actually play, my business grows, my relationships grow, my whole life gets better because I'm happier. Take care of your body, take care of your mind, that's not optional for me anymore.
